text:
sarah (CEO): quick operational follow-up from today's all-hands about headcount reprioritization and the small org tweaks. i'll keep this thread tight and actionable. pls drop short q's.
elena (Head of Talent): quick summary: NOT a company-wide hiring freeze. we're gating new reqs and prioritizing approvals for a few buckets.
dave (CTO): priority buckets are: 1) Serving Runtime (latency/KV/cache), 2) Dedicated Ops (capacity/SLA), 3) Customer Reliability (SRE/incident work). small carve-out for revenue-critical product work.
tom (Dir Eng): can you define "customer reliability" in practice?
dave (CTO): anything that lowers P99, reduces cache miss regressions, or improves autoscaling/failover for paying customers.
jas (Product): PM question 1: how do we request priority for a new role?
elena (Head of Talent): create a ticket in internal/hires, add a one-line metric impact + timeline, and tag @elena + @tom. we'll triage Tues/Thurs.
maya (People Ops): internal mobility: if you want to move into a prioritized team, post in #internal-moves and cc your manager 5 we'll fast-track transfers.
rachel (Eng): will interview panels or loops change?
elena (Head of Talent): yes 5 leaner panels for infra/SRE hires to speed decisions; updated loops published Fri.
sarah (CEO): timeline: org sketches posted Wed EOD; role-to-team mapping in ~2 weeks; prioritized reqs begin intake immediately.
dave (CTO): hiring mix guidance: favor experienced infra ICs for architecture work, keep ~40% mid-level for throughput; juniors only with explicit mentorship pairing.
tom (Dir Eng): manager-level changes?
dave (CTO): expect a few TL swaps to better align skillsets; no mass manager churn planned.
jas (Product): what happens to growth/product hiring (PLG, UX)?
sarah (CEO): still funded but limited slots; tie hires to concrete KPIs or revenue/retention impact to move faster.
maya (People Ops): comp bands stay the same for now. any exceptions will be People Ops + finance approvals.
elena (Head of Talent): candidates in active pipelines 5 continue interviews. deprioritized roles will get candidate outreach and a pause notice.
rachel (Eng): sponsorship/relocation effects?
maya (People Ops): existing offers remain valid. new sponsorship reqs flagged at intake will be reviewed by region and budget.
elena (Head of Talent): SLA-critical hires: tag the hiring ticket "urgent-sla" and include customer name/contract so we bump triage.
sarah (CEO): we'll publish a read-only headcount buckets sheet and a simple org map by Wed. if people want a short AMA follow-up, we'll schedule next week. :thumbsup:
sync-bot: all-hands notes uploaded: internal/allhands/2026-03-hiring-followup.md
